core_note: The discipline they come from or most expect to target. Gets the companies-by-fit table.
disciplines_note: Default is all six. The sweep is cheap and the report ranks every slice together, which is how a marketer finds the PM or strategy pocket they fit. Narrow only once a direction is clear.
max_years_note: Your pre-MBA years of full-time work + 2. Roles that state a higher minimum are marked unreachable, not removed.
location_note: Pick one mode. "us" = US plus postings that name no place (flagged in the report). "us-strict" = confirmed US only. "international" = outside the US only. "anywhere" = no filter. "custom" = only named places, e.g. {"mode":"custom","include":["Utah","Salt Lake","Lehi","Provo","Draper"],"include_remote":true}. Any mode can add "exclude":["New York"]. Applied when scoring, so changing it never needs a re-fetch.
companies_note: "all" = every board in data/boards.json + workspace/my_boards.json. Or a list of company names.
observable_preferences: Example: in-person team (read from the location policy)
Example: owns a number (P&L, revenue, budget language in the posting)
